subject.title: fix(agents): bound SSH sandbox commands with a default timeout

question: Should SSH sandbox operations have a universal 60-second total-command budget, or should the existing OpenSSH handshake timeout remain the only default until an owner-specific operation budget is established?
rationale: The dependency contract undermines the reported pre-banner root cause, while a global deadline changes the supported runtime budget for every current and SDK-exposed caller.

options.title: Keep OpenSSH handshake timing only
options.body: Remove the proposed universal process timeout because `ConnectTimeout 5` already bounds the stated handshake stall; investigate any separately observed post-handshake hang with a real reproducer.

options.title: Adopt explicit operation budgets
options.body: Retain a timeout only after sandbox owners define and test distinct caller-level budgets for operations that can safely fail after a known duration.

recommendation.title: Keep OpenSSH handshake timing only
recommendation.body: Remove the proposed universal process timeout because `ConnectTimeout 5` already bounds the stated handshake stall; investigate any separately observed post-handshake hang with a real reproducer.
